scanner.name: Scanner
scanner.description: Stationary surveillance node with enhanced detection arrays. Cannot attack but sees farther than most security programs.

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.description: Automated security routine that follows predetermined routes. Equipped with basic defensive protocols.

bot.name: Bot
bot.description: Autonomous cleaning script with pattern recognition. Wanders unpredictably while scanning for anomalies.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.description: Heavily fortified security barrier process. Extremely resilient but slow to respond to threats.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Elite security algorithm with advanced threat detection and powerful attack protocols. Highly dangerous.

virus.name: Virus
virus.description: Hostile malware that corrupts on contact. Doesn't deal direct damage but infects systems with degrading code.

inhibitor.name: Inhibitor
inhibitor.description: Traffic control daemon that throttles unauthorized processes. Slows your execution speed without causing damage.

admin.name: Admin Avatar
admin.description: System administrator's digital enforcer. Heavily armed, relentless, and commands root-level privileges.

system_hop.name: System Hop
system_hop.description: Rapidly pivot to any monitoring blind spot within 6 tiles. Instant relocation through pre-established network connections - perfect for repositioning.

traffic_masquerade.name: Traffic Masquerade
traffic_masquerade.description: Masquerade as legitimate traffic patterns. Become completely invisible to security protocols for 5 turns - walk past enemies undetected.

decoy_swarm.name: Decoy Swarm
decoy_swarm.description: Spawn false alerts and decoy processes. Creates a convincing distraction lasting 8 turns - lure enemies away from your path.

buffer_overflow.name: Buffer Overflow
buffer_overflow.description: Overload a target's memory buffer with malicious data. Devastating close-range exploit dealing 40 damage - high risk, high reward.

code_injection.name: Code Injection
code_injection.description: Execute hostile code remotely in a target's process space. Reliable ranged attack dealing 25 damage from up to 5 tiles away.

system_crash.name: System Crash
system_crash.description: Force a critical system error in all nearby processes. Emergency protocol dealing 30 damage and stunning all enemies within 3 tiles for 3 turns.

logic_bomb.name: Logic Bomb
logic_bomb.description: Deploy a delayed-trigger exploit that detonates in a large radius. Deals 15 damage to all targets within 2 tiles of impact point. WARNING: Can damage you if detonated too close!

threat_scan.name: Threat Scan
threat_scan.description: Tap into security monitoring feeds. Reveals all hostile programs, their detection ranges, and predicted movement paths for 5 turns.

network_scan.name: Network Scan
network_scan.description: Query the network topology for maintenance systems. Instantly reveals locations of all cooling nodes, CPU recovery nodes, and ghost nodes.

log_wiper.name: Log Wiper
log_wiper.description: Scrub your activity from system logs and audit trails. Significantly reduces your detection level by 30% - cover your tracks.

antivirus.name: Antivirus
antivirus.description: Run a quarantine protocol on your own systems. Instantly purges all hostile effects like viruses and movement inhibitors.

denial_of_service.name: Denial of Service
denial_of_service.description: Flood a network segment with overwhelming traffic. Area attack disabling all affected enemies for 5 turns in radius 1.

memory_leak.name: Memory Leak
memory_leak.description: Corrupt enemy vision systems in a 3x3 area. Blinded enemies can't see you for 3 turns while they reboot - but they keep moving. Use it to dodge into blind spots!

ram_boost.name: Memory Expansion
ram_boost.description: High-capacity memory module. Permanently expands RAM by 4GB - equip more complex exploits simultaneously.

cpu_boost.name: Processing Core
cpu_boost.description: Overclocked processor upgrade. Permanently increases maximum CPU by 20 - survive more damage and operations.

heat_boost.name: Cooling Matrix
heat_boost.description: Advanced thermal dissipation system. Permanently raises heat tolerance by 20 degrees - execute more exploits before overheating.
